selected_script.angle: Washing greasy pans leaves a slippery, cloudy oil film in the kitchen sink that regular sponges just smear around; Liapu spray instantly dissolves this sink residue for a clean, lemon-fresh, antibacterial finish.
selected_script.hook: Ever wash a greasy pan and it leaves that disgusting oily film all over your stainless steel sink?

script_record.segment_01: Ever wash a greasy pan and it leaves that disgusting oily film all over your stainless steel sink? A regular sponge just spreads it around.
script_record.segment_02: I switched to this Liapu degreaser. Just spray it directly on the slick residue, let it sit for a few seconds, and wipe it away.
script_record.segment_03: It completely cuts through the grease with zero cloudy residue left behind. Plus, it kills 99.9% of bacteria and smells like fresh lemons.
